raw_segments.text: Othello, was this fair paper this most goodly book made to write horror upon?
O thou public commoner, I should make very forges of my cheeks that would to cinders
burn up modesty did I but speak thy deeds.
Heaven stops the nose at it and the moon winks, the body wind that kisses all it meets is
hushed within the hollow mine of earth and will not hear it.
